headline: 10y 4.84% overnight, highest since 2023, Brent above $100, PPI 8:30
stance: Wednesday's yield move was real rates, not breakevens — that is the Fed, not the oil. Hike odds above 60% into the FOMC, Sep 16.

news.head: Brent settled above $100
news.body: First settle above $100 since July, on Wednesday. Brent $101.37 in Asian hours (~3am ET).

news.head: Hike odds above 60%
news.body: Futures price above 60% odds of a hike at the meeting (~4am ET). That was 44% on Aug 7.

news.head: US futures higher pre-market
news.body: S&P +0.22%, Dow +0.36%, Nasdaq -0.04% (~4am ET). Equities fell three straight sessions.

news.head: Apple's foldable ships Oct 23
news.body: iPhone Duo pre-orders Oct 16, ships Oct 23. iPhone 18 Pro from Sep 18, $100 dearer.

implications: Real yields are doing the tightening the Fed has not done yet. That hits multiples before it hits earnings.
Credit is pricing neither $100 crude nor a hike. Either spreads are wrong or the equity drawdown stops here.

watch.head: PPI, Sep 10, 8:30
watch.body: Consensus 5.3% year-over-year, from 4.7% in July. Core seen 4.6% from 4.2%.

watch.head: Jobless claims, Sep 10, 8:30
watch.body: Four-week average 207K through Aug 29. The labor half of the hike case.

watch.head: CPI, Sep 11, 8:30
watch.body: Consumer prices land tomorrow. Today's producer prices set the bar for them.

watch.head: Oil vol
watch.body: OVX 49.85 Wednesday, up two sessions with Brent. Vol is not fading with the headlines.

sections.title: Macro & Rates
bullets: 10y 4.84% overnight (~3am ET), highest since 2023. Higher again before a single US release.
Breakevens sat still Wednesday while real yields rose. Tuesday's move was the mirror image.
Gold rose Wednesday alongside real yields. The two normally move opposite.
sections.positioning: Speculators long gold at the 93rd percentile of three years, a fifth week. Price re-entered its elevated band Wednesday.

sections.title: Equity Markets
bullets: Breadth thinned a 3rd straight session: 36.5% of the S&P above its 50-day, 55.7% above its 200-day.
VXN 22.32 Wednesday, from 20.04 Friday. Equity vol rising with oil vol.
Nasdaq-100 breadth 40.2% above the 50-day, from 44.6% Friday.
sections.positioning: Speculators short Russell 2000 at the 2nd percentile of three years, a 19th week. Standing background, not new.

single_name.note: Granite Ridge Resources: insider buy filed Tuesday, holds its 200-day, 6.07 days to cover. E&P into $100 Brent.

sections.title: Credit & Liquidity
bullets: High yield has outperformed investment grade four straight sessions. Equities fell three.
Nothing in investment grade has repriced since Sep 2. Equity-credit correlation 0.64, from 0.63.
Reverse repo is down to nothing. Reserves are the cushion; balance sheet update at 4:30pm.

ideas.line: 5 open · 0 closed — no hit rate until 10 (too few to mean anything)
